info.name: PizzaHub - Admin Menu API tests
info.description: See docs/ADMIN_MENU_TESTING.md. Run the folders top to bottom, in a fresh Postman session, against a demo database (not your real one).

item.name: 2. Setup (new vendor + customer, admin sign in, 3 pending items)
Vendor: sign up (ok if the user already exists)

exec: pm.test("signed up, or the user already exists", () => pm.expect([200, 400, 409, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test("token received", () => { const t = pm.response.json().token; pm.expect(t).to.be.a("string"); pm.collectionVariables.set("vendorToken", t); });

request.description: Uses the session cookie stored by the sign-in request right above it.

request.description: Uses the session cookie stored by the sign-in request right above it.

item.name: Admin: sign in (account made by `npm run seed:admin`)

exec: pm.test("token received", () => { const t = pm.response.json().token; pm.expect(t).to.be.a("string"); pm.collectionVariables.set("adminToken", t); });

item.name: Vendor: delete own item via admin API

exec: pm.test("the 3 pending items are there, untouched", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().pagination.totalItems).to.equal(3));
pm.test("3 items, newest first", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.length).to.equal(3); pm.expect(d[0]._id).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get("item3Id")); });

pm.test("1 item left on page 2", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.length).to.equal(1); pm.expect(b.pagination.totalPages).to.equal(2); pm.expect(b.pagination.hasPreviousPage).to.equal(true); });
pm.test("status approved", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.equal(true); pm.expect(b.data.status).to.equal("approved"); });
